notation.fixtures: A fixture extends at most one earlier fixture. Apply state_patch by exact key replacement, then remove absent_state_fields; files_add/files_remove operate on the existence set. Case patches follow fixture expansion.
notation.state_sequence: The legacy comma-separated stage sequence is normalized to an ordered JSON array. Field names and 1-based stage indexes are retained.
notation.state_subset: Only listed postcondition fields are asserted. Omitted fields are unknown unless state_unchanged explicitly names them.
notation.semantic_assumptions: Tests supply semantic facts and coherent artifact bodies explicitly. Fixtures do not prescribe initializer defaults or an artifact parser.
notation.scopes: procedure cases assert local effects only; recovery/global admission may prevent invocation. sequence cases with unresolved fields assert a prefix/partial trace, not successful complete execution.
notation.status: selected/uncovered/inconsistent_facts/invalid_shape/unresolved describe extraction assertions, not production status values or error codes.
notation.gaps: A spec_notes reference records a specification boundary or an explicit source-precedence resolution. Open notes are not expected-success waivers; affected assertions cannot establish end-to-end parity.
